results.title: Murder on the Newfie Bullet
results.overview: As Newfoundland and Labrador hurtles toward its Confederation vote, a murder aboard the infamous train turns a routine journey into a chaotic political whodunit where every passenger has a motive, and the future of a nation might just be riding on a narrow gauge.

results.title: Matter of Time
results.overview: Eddie Vedder's soul-stirring Seattle benefit concert fuels this documentary about the race to cure the rare genetic disorder epidermolysis bullosa (EB).

results.title: Picture Girl
results.overview: A nonverbal autistic teenager develops a quiet crush on the girl next door, expressing her feelings through drawn portraits.

results.title: Christmas Roses
results.overview: A grieving young girl and a reclusive woman form an unlikely bond during Christmas, helping each other rediscover joy and find healing through the season's magic.

results.title: DISC
results.overview: The story of a hookup gone too far up.

results.title: I Wish You Had Told Me
results.overview: When a young missionary uncovers his late father's long-held secret, he travels from the Philippines to Spain in search of his dad's forbidden love.

results.title: Winter in Sokcho
results.overview: In the snowy seaside town of Sokcho, 25-year-old Soo-Ha works at a guesthouse. She drifts between her mother’s fish stall and her boyfriend until a French artist’s arrival stirs questions about her identity. As winter deepens, Soo-Ha and the artist form an unspoken connection through food and art.

results.title: The diva, my grandma and me
results.original_title: La diva, mi abuela y yo
results.overview: Inés and her grandmother Esperanza have always had a special relationship, but she waited until she turned thirty to ask her to tell her about her youth. Her grandmother opens the box of memories, determined to share details of her life that she had never shared before. The photographs from the family archive come to life with the rhythm of the songs hummed by her grandmother. The lyrics of "Batallón de modistillas," a cuplé from the late 19th century, set Inés's heart on fire and she begins to search.

results.title: The Shadow Of Us
results.overview: A lonely photographer escapes into a drug-induced dreamworld that grants his deepest desires, until his fantasy begins to consume him.

results.title: Saint Vegas
results.overview: A young woman, Anastasia, escapes far from home to work as a non-sexual escort in Las Vegas in an attempt to suppress her feelings after losing her mother. On one particular night she meets an older woman, Carmen, who tests her emotional boundaries and opens the floodgates to Anastasia’s grief. In the face of her deepest fears, Anastasia decides to head back home to confront all she’s left behind.

results.title: Trillion Game
results.original_title: 劇場版 トリリオンゲーム
results.overview: Haru Tennoji and Manabu "Gaku" Taira are once again on the move to earn 1 trillion dollars and get everything in the world. Haru Tennoji turns his attention to a new business which is to develop the first casino resort in Japan. Will Haru and Gaku's use of unpredictable strategies and bluffing allow them to earn a trillion dollars?

results.title: TKO
results.overview: After reuniting with his estranged sons, a former boxer must step up as a father and a coach when his oldest begins competing in professional boxing.

results.title: Outside
results.overview: A man attempts to escape the clutches of his psychotic overbearing mother, who has kept him locked inside for most of his life…

results.title: Nocturne
results.overview: In the stormy darkness of a restless night, a child, unable to sleep, wanders through the vastness of a house. Lightning transforms the home, and an unexpected encounter will mark her nocturnal journey."

results.title: Sharing Aloha
results.overview: A backstage exploration of what it means for young Islanders to preserve and pass on the culture of their ancestors, diving behind the scenes for a rare look into one of Hawaii's most popular (and least understood) tourist stops.

results.title: Soma
results.overview: It's New Year's Eve in Brooklyn and Annika doesn't have anything to wear to the party that her best friend Beccs is performing at and her ex is hosting...because nothing fits. Throughout her night she undergoes the push and pull of trying to be okay with herself and her surroundings.

results.title: That Door
results.overview: When Del revisits his struggling local corner-shop, a chance encounter with a wayward coin sets in motion a surreal journey through a mysterious door.

results.title: A Dog Named Palma 2
results.overview: After leaving commercial aviation, Vyacheslav Lazarev and his family move to the countryside, where he continues to go flying, but now on a small propellered AN-2. And the life of the Lazarev family goes on as usual, until one day a small bear cub, to whom Kolya, the pilot’s son, gives the nickname Mansur, bursts in. When Mansur is kidnapped by local poachers, the faithful sheepdog Palma comes to his aid. The two animals need to find their way home through a forest full of wild animals, hunters and other dangers. And the Lazarevs, who set off in search of their four-legged friends, will have to remember what it means to be a real family.
